topic: Job interview roleplay: tell me about yourself

script.title: Tell me about yourself – job interview roleplay

lines.text: Let's start easy. Tell me about yourself.
I'm a designer. I've worked on shopping apps for three years, and now I'd love to grow here.
Nice and clear. So why do you want to join us?
Kit's tip: present, past, future. Who you are, what you've done, and what you want next.

script.caption: How to answer "Tell me about yourself" in a job interview
